entries.observation: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. Observed heading: "NASED Welcome The National Association of State Election Directors promotes accessible, accurate, and transparent elections in the United States and U.S. Territories. NASED is a nonpartisan professional organization that disseminates election administration best practices and information across the states. Our members are Election Directors from across the country, many of whom have worked in election administration at state and local level for decades. In each state, they are responsible for implementing election laws and policies, maintaining voter registration databases, working with local officials." Links: frequently asked questions, communications toolkit, How to Register to Vote, Check Your Voter Registration, Apply for Absentee Ballot, Find Your Polling Place, Serve as Election Worker.

entries.observation: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. Observed heading: "Citizen Voting Age Population by Race and Ethnicity". Text: "A Citizen Voting Age by Race and Ethnicity (CVAP) special tabulation was originally created from the Census 2000 long form. This original CVAP special tabulation was produced at request of group of data users and published in 2002 for use in voting rights analysis. At request of Department of Justice, U.S. Census Bureau began publishing annual CVAP special tabulation from most current American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates starting with 2005-2009 5-year estimates, released Feb 2011." Links: 2024 tab (2020-2024 ACS), 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020 etc. Files: CSV and SAS formats, geographies Nation State Congressional District State Legislative District County Place MCD Tract Block Groups, Technical Documentation PDF, 119th Congressional Districts and 2024 State Legislative Districts, reference date Jan 1 2024. Contact rdo@census.gov.
